additionalInformation: The item's attributes grants the following additional bonuses:
120 mana, 0.5 mana regeneration and 1% flat base magic resistance.
7 main attack damage to universal heroes.
Stacks with all other movement speed bonuses.
Purges first, then applies Cyclone modifier.
description: A mysterious scepter passed down through the ages, its disruptive winds can be used for good or evil.
trivia: The scepter's name (and flavor text) is a reference to Eul, the creator of the first DotA map back in 2002.
Crystal Maiden's cosmetic item, Eul's Scepter of Divinity, is based on Eul's Scepter of Divinity and shares its name.
tips: Using Eul's Scepter of Divinity on the enemy to stop their chase to interrupt their commitment in a group fight.
When being overwhelmed, using Eul's Scepter of Divinity is not a mean to escape since it immobilizes you, but a way to counterattack because it does the following things:
Beware of the Nullifier. If you use the scepter after being Nullified, it will have almost no effect than the basic dispel as the cyclone effect will be immediately dispelled.

notes: Cyclones cast on yourself go through spell immunity.
Cyclone can dispel some buffs and debuffs.
Cyclone duration is unaffected by status resistance.
abilities.description:
Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for 2.5 seconds. Cyclone can only be cast on enemy units or yourself.

Enemy units take 50 magical damage upon landing.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

name: Eul's Scepter of Divinity
